verses.pali: “Nāhaṁ, bhikkhave, aññaṁ ekarūpampi samanupassāmi yaṁ evaṁ itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhati yathayidaṁ, bhikkhave, purisarūpaṁ.
verses.english: “Mendicants, I do not see a single sight that occupies a woman’s mind like the sight of a man.

verses.pali: Purisarūpaṁ, bhikkhave, itthiyā cittaṁ pariyādāya tiṭṭhatī”ti.
verses.english: The sight of a man occupies a woman’s mind.”
